UNION SUITE / TAB DISPLAY STUDY

Tab display options V5 / H2 APPROVED

Five vertical menus. Three horizontal menus. Each uses the accent differently, across CCOs, standalone tabbed displays and nested Address tabs.

The full example below uses the approved shared theme. Earlier options remain here for comparison.

Approved pairing: V5 Warm attached tabs + H2 Attached tabs. View the selected combination

Vertical · V1–V5Horizontal · H1–H3Try a combination

Vertical menus

Five vertical treatments, including two open-right variations. The sample menus stay vertical for comparison; the full example adapts to narrow screens.

V1Midnight

Dark continuous menu. A solid accent block makes the current section unmistakable.

V2Inset cards

Soft grey menu with individual white rows. Selection uses an accent outline and a warm tint.

V3Accent rail

A full accent-colour menu. The current row turns white with a dark edge.

V4Open-right tabs

H2 turned vertically: a white selected tab opens into the content on its right, with an accent left edge.

V5Warm attached tabsAPPROVED

V2 colouring meets V4 geometry: white inactive rows, a warm accent selection fading to white at the open right edge, joining a white panel.

Horizontal menus

Different structures, not just colour changes. Each style also applies to Address and other nested tab strips.

H1Segmented track

A single neutral track with a raised accent segment for the current tab.

H2Attached tabsAPPROVED

Folder-style tabs attached to the content surface, with an accent cap on the selected tab.

H3Accent bar

A continuous accent bar with a dark selected tab. A bolder, flatter treatment.

Try them together

Approved V5 + H2. Switch the Address tabs and try the standalone display below the account panel.

Preview

Approved implementation & archived trials

V5 and H2 are approved and implemented in zUnionSuite.css and zUnionSuite.js. The combined example uses those shared sources. The other six designs and trial CSS are retained as an archive. One horizontal choice covers top-level CCOs, nested Address tabs and standalone native tabbed displays; the vertical choice applies to native vertical strips. Banner markup remains a separate component.

Native targets.RadTabStrip and .RadTabStripVertical, with their direct .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink chain. Styling does not require a CCO ancestor or a generated ID.
Preview placementus-tab-study plus one us-tabs-v1/v2/v3/v4/v5 and one us-tabs-h1/h2/h3 on a common ancestor. These are trial comparison modifiers, not installed author classes. Nested displays inherit the horizontal choice automatically.
Colour tokensAccent fills/caps/outlines use --accent; warm selections use --accent-100; text on accent uses --text-on-accent. Dark surfaces use --brand-900; light surfaces use --bg-surface and --bg-sunken. All tokens are read from the shared theme at build time.
Responsive layoutOn mobile (600px or below), H2 uses a single scrolling row, including nested and standalone tabs. Other horizontal trials retain wrapping. In the full preview, the 220px vertical menu becomes a scrolling row at 600px or below. V4 opens right into a white content panel; V5 uses the same opening with V2’s grey rail, white inactive rows and warm accent selection, fading the selected tab to white at the open edge while the adjoining panel stays white with a neutral grey border. Both become scrolling top rows with a bottom opening at narrow widths; V5 uses a solid pale accent selection and top cap. Mobile targets are at least 44px high. Full vertical examples offer an All sections disclosure for direct navigation; overflowing rows show edge fades and reveal the selected tab automatically. Menu-only swatches deliberately remain vertical; V4 and V5 include a slice of the adjacent panel. Those swatch overrides are confined to fixture CSS.
InteractionEvery tabset has independent selection, ARIA state, arrow keys, Home/End and disabled-tab skipping. Changing an outer tab preserves nested selection. The mobile All sections list reflects selected and disabled states; selection closes it and focuses the tab, and Escape closes it and returns focus to its trigger. The approved example uses UnionSuiteTabs for mobile navigation; only dummy panel switching belongs to the fixture. The Address + action is an unavailable demo placeholder. Native iMIS owns panel selection and requests; the shared All sections adapter activates the existing native tab.
Production limitsThis demonstrates the supplied Orion/Telerik markup family. Other skins, scroll-button modes, right/bottom placement and unrelated custom tab widgets need inspection before claiming support. No server postbacks, validation or real records are used. Live iMIS must retain native selection, keyboard and refresh behaviour; do not deploy the fixture controller.

All eight styles — comparison CSS
/* TRIAL: eight alternatives for native tab displays, including nested tabs.
   .us-tab-study and us-tabs-h1..h3 / us-tabs-v1..v5 live on the preview body.
   No CCO ancestor or generated ID is required. Every native strip is styled.
   Load after native Orion CSS and the shared UnionSuite tokens.
   These are comparison modifiers, not production author classes. */
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) {
  --rail-bg: transparent; --rail-border: transparent; --rail-radius: 0px; --rail-pad: 6px;
  --tab-bg: transparent; --tab-color: var(--text-base); --tab-border: transparent;
  --tab-radius: 6px; --tab-gap: 4px; --tab-pad: 10px 16px; --tab-height: 40px;
  --active-bg: var(--accent); --active-color: var(--text-on-accent); --active-border: var(--accent); --active-shadow: none;
  --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --hover-color: var(--brand-900); --hover-border: transparent;
  --focus-color: var(--border-focus);
  margin: 0; padding: 0; min-width: 0;
  background: var(--rail-bg); border: 1px solid var(--rail-border); border-radius: var(--rail-radius);
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel {
  width: auto; padding: var(--rail-pad); border: 0; height: auto;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--tab-gap); float: none;
  width: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL::after { display: none; }
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI {
  display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; float: none; margin: 0; padding: 0;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; float: none; width: auto;
  min-height: var(--tab-height); margin: 0; padding: var(--tab-pad);
  border: 1px solid var(--tab-border); border-radius: var(--tab-radius);
  background: var(--tab-bg); color: var(--tab-color);
  font: var(--fw-semi) 13px/1.5 var(--font-ui); text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink :is(.rtsOut, .rtsIn, .rtsTxt) {
  display: block; float: none; padding: 0; background: none; line-height: inherit; text-align: inherit;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:hover {
  background: var(--hover-bg); border-color: var(--hover-border); color: var(--hover-color);
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected {
  background: var(--active-bg); border-width: 1px; border-color: var(--active-border); color: var(--active-color); box-shadow: var(--active-shadow);
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:active {
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .2);
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus-color); outline-offset: -4px;
}
.us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:is(.rtsDisabled, [aria-disabled="true"]) {
  opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--tab-bg); color: var(--tab-color);
  border-color: var(--tab-border); box-shadow: none;
}
/* Horizontal 1: a single segmented track, with an accent-filled selection. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h1 .RadTabStrip {
  --rail-bg: var(--bg-sunken); --rail-border: var(--border); --rail-radius: 10px; --rail-pad: 5px;
  --tab-pad: 8px 15px; --tab-height: 36px; --tab-radius: 7px;
  --active-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .15); --hover-bg: var(--bg-surface);
}
/* Horizontal 2: attached folder tabs with a strong accent cap. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip {
  --rail-pad: 4px 4px 0; --tab-gap: 3px; --tab-radius: 7px 7px 0 0;
  --tab-bg: var(--bg-sunken); --tab-border: var(--border); --tab-pad: 10px 16px;
  --active-bg: var(--bg-surface); --active-color: var(--brand-900); --active-border: var(--border);
  --active-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 var(--accent); --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --hover-border: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--border);
}
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected:hover:not(:where(.rtsDisabled, [aria-disabled="true"])) {
  border-color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--bg-surface);
}
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip + .RadMultiPage {
  background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: 0; padding: 16px;
}
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected {
  border-bottom-color: var(--bg-surface); margin-bottom: -1px; padding-bottom: 11px;
}
/* Horizontal 3: an accent bar with a dark selected tab. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h3 .RadTabStrip {
  --rail-bg: var(--accent); --rail-radius: 4px; --rail-pad: 5px;
  --tab-color: var(--text-on-accent); --tab-radius: 3px; --tab-height: 36px; --tab-pad: 8px 16px;
  --active-bg: var(--brand-900); --active-color: var(--text-inverse); --active-border: var(--brand-900);
  --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --focus-color: var(--text-inverse);
}
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-h3 .RadTabStrip > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:not(.rtsSelected):focus-visible { outline-color: var(--brand-900); }
/* Layout applies to native organisers; styling above also covers standalone strips. */
.us-tab-study .tabs-wrapper.tabs-vertical {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0; align-items: stretch;
}
.us-tab-study .tabs-wrapper.tabs-vertical > .RadTabStripVertical { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; align-self: stretch; }
.us-tab-study .tabs-wrapper.tabs-vertical > .RadMultiPage { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 18px 24px; }
.us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel { height: 100%; }
.us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical.RadTabStrip_Orion > .rtsLevel.rtsLevel1 { border: 0; }
.us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL { flex-direction: column; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
.us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink { width: 100%; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
/* Vertical 1: dark, continuous background and a solid accent selection. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-v1 .RadTabStripVertical {
  --rail-bg: var(--brand-900); --rail-radius: 10px; --rail-pad: 12px 10px;
  --tab-color: var(--text-inverse); --tab-pad: 10px 16px; --tab-height: 42px;
  --hover-bg: var(--brand-800); --hover-color: var(--text-inverse); --focus-color: var(--accent);
}
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-v1 .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--brand-900); }
/* Vertical 2: individual rows inset into a soft background. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-v2 .RadTabStripVertical {
  --rail-bg: var(--bg-sunken); --rail-border: var(--border); --rail-radius: 12px; --rail-pad: 12px;
  --tab-bg: var(--bg-surface); --tab-border: var(--border); --tab-gap: 6px; --tab-radius: 7px;
  --tab-height: 42px; --tab-pad: 10px 14px;
  --active-bg: var(--accent-100); --active-color: var(--brand-900); --active-border: var(--accent);
  --active-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent); --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --hover-border: var(--accent);
}
/* Vertical 3: a full accent background with a white selected row. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-v3 .RadTabStripVertical {
  --rail-bg: var(--accent); --rail-radius: 4px; --rail-pad: 12px 0;
  --tab-color: var(--text-on-accent); --tab-radius: 0px; --tab-gap: 0px; --tab-pad: 11px 18px; --tab-height: 44px;
  --active-bg: var(--bg-surface); --active-color: var(--brand-900); --active-border: var(--bg-surface);
  --active-shadow: inset 5px 0 0 var(--brand-900); --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --focus-color: var(--brand-900);
}
/* Vertical 4/5 share the open-right geometry. V4 uses H2's white surface;
   V5 fades V2's warm selection to white before the join into the panel. */
.us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) { --open-surface: var(--bg-surface); --open-border: var(--border); }
.us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical {
  --rail-pad: 4px 0 4px 4px; --tab-gap: 4px; --tab-radius: 7px 0 0 7px;
  --tab-bg: var(--bg-sunken); --tab-border: var(--open-border); --tab-pad: 10px 16px;
  --active-bg: var(--open-surface); --active-color: var(--brand-900); --active-border: var(--open-border);
  --active-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent); --hover-bg: var(--accent-100);
  border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--open-border);
}
.us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical + .RadMultiPage {
  background: var(--open-surface); border: 1px solid var(--open-border); border-left: 0;
}
.us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected {
  width: calc(100% + 1px); margin-right: -1px; border-right-color: var(--open-surface); z-index: 1;
}
/* V5: V2's grey menu, white inactive rows and warm accent selected state,
   using V4's attached shape. The selected fill fades into a white panel. */
.us-tab-study.us-tabs-v5 .RadTabStripVertical {
  --rail-bg: var(--bg-sunken); --tab-bg: var(--bg-surface); --tab-border: var(--border);
  --fade-direction: to right;
  --active-bg: linear-gradient(var(--fade-direction), var(--accent-100) 0%, var(--accent-100) 78%, var(--bg-surface) 100%); --active-border: var(--accent);
  --hover-bg: var(--accent-100); --hover-border: var(--accent);
}
.mobile-sections { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .us-tab-study:not(.menu-swatch).us-tabs-v5 .RadTabStripVertical { --active-bg: var(--accent-100); }
  .us-tab-study:not(.menu-swatch) :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) { --tab-height: 44px; }
  .us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip > .rtsLevel { overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; scrollbar-width: thin; }
  .us-tab-study.us-tabs-h2 .RadTabStrip > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .us-tab-study:not(.menu-swatch) .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel[data-more-right="true"] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, #000 calc(100% - 16px), transparent); }
  .us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel[data-more-left="true"] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 16px); }
  .us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel[data-more-left="true"][data-more-right="true"] { mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 16px, #000 calc(100% - 16px), transparent); }
  .us-tab-study .mobile-sections { display: block; position: relative; z-index: 5; margin: 0 4px 6px; color: var(--text-base); }
  .mobile-sections summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface); font: var(--fw-semi) 13px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
  .mobile-sections summary::after { content: '⌄'; }
  .mobile-sections[open] summary::after { content: '⌃'; }
  .mobile-section-options { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; right: 0; max-height: 280px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px; background: var(--bg-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / .14); }
  .mobile-section-options button { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--text-base); font: 13px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; }
  .mobile-section-options button:is(:hover, [aria-current="true"]) { background: var(--accent-100); color: var(--brand-900); }
  .mobile-section-options button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .mobile-sections :is(summary, button):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: -3px; }
  .us-tab-study.us-tabs-v5 .RadTabStripVertical { --fade-direction: to bottom; }
  .us-tab-study .tabs-wrapper.tabs-vertical { display: block; }
  .us-tab-study .tabs-wrapper.tabs-vertical > .RadMultiPage { padding: 20px 0 0; }
  .us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel { overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
  .us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL { flex-direction: row; }
  .us-tab-study .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink { white-space: nowrap; }
  .us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical {
    --rail-bg: var(--open-surface); --rail-pad: 4px 4px 0; --tab-radius: 7px 7px 0 0; --active-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 var(--accent);
    border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0;
  }
  .us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel { overflow-x: auto; }
  .us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL { flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected {
    width: auto; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: -1px;
    border-right-color: var(--active-border); border-bottom-color: var(--open-surface);
  }
  .us-tab-study:is(.us-tabs-v4, .us-tabs-v5) .RadTabStripVertical + .RadMultiPage {
    border: 1px solid var(--open-border); border-top: 0; padding: 18px;
  }
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink.rtsSelected { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: -2px; }
  .us-tab-study :is(.RadTabStrip, .RadTabStripVertical) > .rtsLevel > .rtsUL > .rtsLI > .rtsLink:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed CanvasText; outline-offset: -5px; }
}
